trichophytic-closure.text: Hair transplant patients and surgeons use trichophytic closure after strip harvesting so hair grows through the donor scar, making a short haircut look cleaner. Evidence for the camouflage comes from small comparative studies.

platelet-rich-fibrin-for-hair.text: Users and clinics try PRF off-label for thinning hair, as a relative of PRP, hoping growth factors will thicken hair. It is documented mainly in dentistry and oral surgery, and hair-specific research is very limited.

hair-micropigmentation.text: Men with hair loss get scalp micropigmentation to create the look of a buzz cut, add apparent density to a thin crown, or hide transplant scars. The visible result is immediate and is described mainly in press coverage rather than trials.

eyelash-implants.text: People seeking permanently fuller lashes consider eyelash transplantation, which places hair into the eyelid margin. It is distinct from extensions and false lashes, and the sources reviewed describe its history but give no outcome studies.

chain: Extensions or mesh added to own hair
artificial-hair-integrations.text: Users with thinning hair or alopecia use weaves, hairpieces and integration systems to add length, volume and coverage right away. The cosmetic result is visible on application; traction and adhesive issues are documented separately.

scalp-cooling-cap.text: Chemotherapy patients wear scalp cooling caps to keep more of their hair through treatment. The use is studied in trials, mainly in breast cancer patients; it is a hair-preservation tool rather than a general hair-growth aid.

intralesional-corticosteroid-scalp-injec.text: Dermatologists inject triamcinolone into small patches of alopecia areata, including eyebrow loss, to restore hair in those spots. Reported regrowth is high, though spontaneous remission complicates interpreting the studies.

in-office-laser-whitening.text: People wanting a brighter smile in one visit choose in-office whitening with a light or laser unit. The shade change is visible straight away; whether the light adds anything beyond the gel is still debated.

chain: Noticeably whiter teeth in one session
zoom-whitening.text: Zoom is a branded dentist-applied whitening session people book for a quick, visibly whiter smile, typically before events or other cosmetic work. Shade improvement is routinely recorded, as in other in-office power bleaching.

chain: Dark gum layer is removed or bleached
Smile looks brighter and more even
gum-depigmentation.text: People with dark, melanin-pigmented gums have them lightened by scalpel, laser or chemical methods for a more even pink gumline. The color change is visible after healing, and support so far is small comparison trials.

chain: Dentist shaves small amounts of enamel
enameloplasty-tooth-reshaping.text: Users get tooth reshaping to smooth chips, even out edges or tweak tooth length quickly, sometimes in place of braces. The change is immediate and visible; no appearance-focused studies were found.

porcelain-veneers.text: Veneers are used to change tooth color, shape, size or gaps in one makeover, and are a staple of smile-focused looksmaxxing. The result is plainly visible, and follow-up studies report long-lasting restorations.

maryland-bridge.text: People missing a tooth use a Maryland bridge to fill the gap with little drilling of neighboring teeth. The gap is visibly closed once placed, and debonding is the usual failure noted in the literature.

chain: Gum tissue moved over exposed roots
gum-graft.text: Gum grafts are done mainly for recession, and some seek them to cover exposed roots and even out the gumline for a better smile. The surgical result is visible once healed; the cosmetic use is secondary to the dental one.

gum-lift.text: Users with a gummy smile or short-looking teeth have the gumline reshaped to show more tooth, overlapping with crown lengthening. The change is visible after healing; evidence specific to cosmetic use is thin.

internal-bleaching.text: People with a single darkened root-canal-treated tooth, often at the front, use internal bleaching to match it to the rest of the smile. Reports describe high immediate success, with some re-treatment needed.

chain: Longer teeth and fuller lower face
bite-reclamation.text: Those with teeth worn down by grinding or acid use bite reclamation to rebuild height, which can make the lower face look less shortened. It is part of full-mouth reconstruction; sources are thin and no trials were found.

chain: Model or temporaries of planned teeth
Preview shows size, shape, smile line
Final veneers match the chosen look
wax-up-smile-mock-up.text: Patients planning veneers use a wax-up or mock-up to see proposed tooth changes against their lips and smile before committing. The preview itself is visible and testable in the mouth; published sourcing is thin.

chain: Jaw bone is cut and repositioned
surgical-orthodontics.text: Looksmaxxers consider jaw surgery with braces to correct bite, airway and facial imbalance, including recessed or overlong jaws. It is established medicine, and the changes in jaw position and profile are visible afterward.

chain: Four implants hold a full arch
all-on-4.text: People with failing teeth choose All-on-4 to get a full fixed arch in a new, uniform smile, which looksmaxxing culture files under hardmaxx dental work. It is established dental surgery with high reported survival, aimed at tooth loss rather than facial change.

damon-self-ligating-braces.text: Forum users rate Damon braces highly and credit them with arch expansion, even jaw or maxilla changes. They are marketed for low friction and non-extraction treatment; reviews find mostly mixed benefits, and jaw-forward claims are unproven.

teeth-whitening-pens.text: Users reach for whitening pens as a portable, at-home way to brighten their smile between other treatments. Evidence on pens specifically comes from laboratory studies.

peroxycarboxylic-pap-whitening.text: PAP is promoted as a peroxide-free whitening agent for people who want lighter teeth with less sensitivity. The support is one small laser-activated study.

chain: Tabs A1 to D4 rate tooth color
vita-shade-guide.text: Dentists and whitening-focused users use the VITA scale to put a number on how light teeth are before and after treatment. It is a measurement reference rather than a treatment, and is widely used in cosmetic dentistry.

temporal-brow-lift.text: Patients and looksmaxxing communities seek it to lift a drooping brow tail and open up the eye area, grouping it with eye-area surgery. The lift is visible after surgery and is documented in surgical series, with debate over technique.

cheek-lift.text: Cheek lifts are used in facial rejuvenation to raise midface tissue, and some young men discuss them for a more defined look. The studies concern aging faces; claims for young men are untested.

chain: Brow, nose, cheek and jaw reshaped
facial-feminization-surgery.text: Developed for transgender women, FFS is now eyed by some looksmaxxers for brow bone, nose and cheek work to improve facial harmony. The surgical changes are visible; use for male faces is discussed in forums.

zygomatic-reduction.text: People with a wide or prominent midface seek cheekbone reduction, popular in Asian aesthetic surgery, for a narrower face. The change is visible after healing; the wiki's sources contain no outcome studies.

serdev-suture.text: Users consider Serdev suture lifting as a minimally invasive option within the thread-lift family for lifting facial tissue. The lift is visible when placed; published evidence on this specific technique is thin.

chain: Own fat injected into facial muscle
facial-autologous-muscular-injection-fam.text: Aesthetic clinics use FAMI, a fat-grafting variant, to restore volume and contour in the face with the patient's own fat. It appears alongside lipostructure in a 2007 review, and little is published on it specifically.
